# Mirasonic v0.1.0

The first public release of Mirasonic: a self-hosted Subsonic server backed by
the anonymous YouTube Music catalogue.

## Highlights

- Search and play YouTube Music from Amperfy.
- Keep playlists and starred tracks in a local SQLite library.
- Import Spotify playlists from an Exportify CSV.
- Run the service with Docker Compose without a Google account or cookies.
- Bind to loopback by default and keep the container filesystem read-only.

## Installation

```sh
git clone https://github.com/rilya888/Mirasonic.git
cd Mirasonic
cp .env.example .env
$EDITOR .env
docker compose up -d --build
```

Read the README before exposing the service. Mirasonic has no TLS of its own and
must not be published directly to the internet.

## Compatibility

This release is tested with Amperfy on iOS. Other Subsonic clients may work but
have not yet been verified.

## Known limitations

- Age-restricted tracks do not play anonymously.
- Artists and albums are derived from tracks already in the local library.
- There is no multi-user support, transcoding, lyrics, podcasts, or radio.
- Upstream changes to YouTube's internal interfaces may temporarily break playback.

Mirasonic is not affiliated with YouTube, Google, Subsonic, or Amperfy.
